title: Route data and custom hooks
summary: Reuse the useFetch hook on a list page and on a detail page whose request is keyed on the id from useParams, so every route owns its own loading, success, and error state. You will tell a product the server no longer has from a failed request, write a useLocalStorage hook that remembers saved products across runs, and read how custom hooks relate to the built-in ones.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
